content.title: Prepare For Battle
content.body:
Time to slain the bosses that reign over the big structures of the overworld. But first make sure you have a proper loadout.
    §lWeapons:
      - Stone weapons: found in §ochests §rinside §oabandoned structures, shipwrecks §rand §ovillage chests; Also dropped by §oZombies§r.
      - Leather Strengthened Bows/Crossbows
      - Fire and Poison Staffs
      - Magic Wand
      - Spells: §oMagic Missile.
    §lBaubles:
      - Emerald Ring/Amulet: Craftable or found as treasure.
      - Weird Shiny Object: Rarely found in §oruined structures§r.
      - Wolf/Bear Cape: Crafted using §owolf/bear pelts§r.
      - Bezoar: 3% chance to drop from §opoisonous mobs§r.
      - Vitamins: 3% chance to drop from §ofatigue/weakness-inflicting mobs§r.
      - Charms: 10% chance to drop from §oany hostile mob §rwhile in the dark §r(light level 0)
      - Potion Rings: Crafted using §oEmpty Rings§r. Might be difficult to make based on if you have §oGlowing Powder§r. A rare treasure material.
    §lMisc:
      - Healing: Craftable §oHealing Potions§r. Enemies can also drop §obandages §rand other healing items.
      - Lunch Bag: Used to store up to three stacks of food.
